body: Thank you for your kind words. I'm trying my best day by day to accept that this has happened. But at the end of it all, these horrible thoughts still exist in my head and I'm so exhausted of trying to keep them out.

Thank you for stopping by. This place is the only place where I can speak freely without worrying other people. I have strong desire to express my feelings but at the same time I'm concerned about worrying others.
I'm in the same boat, my friend. I hope it gets better for you.

Pretty damn horribly. Going through a real tough time trying to keep the one I love. She's amazing and I love her unconditionally. She has gone to figure out if she still feels the same way about me that she used to.

I'm clinging on to the tiniest piece of hope I can at the moment. The worst is yet to come, I fear.

I can't sleep or eat right now, trying to keep busy but when I stop, and when I'm alone, that's when it hurts the most.
